rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow, unanimous opinion holding that algorithmic recommendations are part of the traditional publisher functions covered by §230(c)(1), with an alternative (or reinforcing) ground that the complaint fails Taamneh’s knowing-and-substantial-assistance standard under ATA/JASTA. Separate writings are most likely from Justices Thomas or Gorsuch to elaborate the common-law/ordinary-meaning account of “publisher” and to flag that any recalibration of §230 should come from Congress.
